 Penn State vs. Pitt Preview: Can the Nittany Lions Win the Battle of the Cats?
 Can Penn State snap their six-game losing streak against the Panthers?
 by Lando Nov 8, 2026, 8:30 PM UTC Facebook 
 Link 
 How To Watch
 Who: Pitt Panthers
 Record: 2-0, 0-0 ACC
 When: 8:00 PM Sunday, November 8th, 2026
 Where: The Palestra, Philadelphia, PA
 TV: ESPN 2
 Radio: Penn State Sports Network 
 Vegas Line: Penn State +2.5
 Over/Under: 154.5
 What To Watch For
 First to 85 wins this one. In both of their victories this season, the Panthers have scored 95 and 80 points, respectively. Meanwhile, Penn State has scored 97 in both of their matchups so far, blowing out Canisus and narrowly escaping Chattanooga on Thursday. Keeping pace with Pitt will be essential in order to get the victory. 
 Rocking with Roko In order for the Nittany Lions to get the win, they will need their newest star to duplicate the effort he gave in the season opener. Roko Prkacin had 28 points on 12/14 shooting, and added six rebounds in the dominant win over Canisus, but scored just 13 points in the nail-biter over Chattanooga despite playing four more minutes. Prkacin, along with several others, will need to score at least 20 for Penn State to come out on top. 
 Can Penn State stop the two forwards? Pitt is led by dual 6’9” forwards, freshman Chase Foster, who leads the Panthers with 21 points, four rebounds, and four blocks per game, and senior Baye Ndongo, who is second in scoring with 17.5 points per game, and leads the team in rebounding with 13.5 per contest. Both of these players will need to be held in check by the likes of Ivan Juric and Josh Reed. Can they do it? 
 Prediction
 Pitt wins its sixth straight over the good guys. Penn State makes it somewhat competitive, but there’s not enough defense in this one.
 Pitt 84 , Penn State 78
